_comment: FluidServe's per-token form of the swe promise: TTFT 7 s in this file, and 75 ms per token through --fluidserve-class-budgets 25:decode:75. tbt_ms stays 25 because it is the TIER KEY the profile lookup and every log line name the class by, not a budget. Policies that read tbt_ms literally must use the sibling *_t75fair file, or they judge swe three times tighter than it is promised.
